opening_annotation.strategic_intent: The opening focuses on a quick expansion while producing early combat units from a Barracks, with gas and an Orbital Command upgrade. It aims to secure an economic lead and establish a strong foundation for mid-game play.
supporting_facts: The opening has a 100% first expansion observed rate, compared to a 17.3% baseline, indicating a strong emphasis on early expansion.
The opening has a 98.7% first gas observed rate, compared to a 72.3% baseline, showing early gas collection.
The opening has a 99.9% first production observed rate and a 99.9% barracks presence, indicating early Barracks construction.
The medoid key sequence is 'Prod_Barracks > Gas > Gas2 > BaseUpgrade_OrbitalCommand > Combat_bio > Base', showing a Barracks first, then two gas, Orbital Command, bio units, and expansion.
